title: Hai Waqt e Sahar Khoon Mein Tar Waris e Qur'aan
body:
Ya ali maula ali, maula ali..(2)
Hai waqt e sahar khoon mein tar waris e qur'aan..(3)
roti hai azaa'n masjid e kufa bhi hai giryaa
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Lo aaj se aghaaz hua karbobala ka
Makhduma e kaunain ka jaari huwa girya
marqad mein Mohammad bhi nazar aaye pareshaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kya zeher mein doobi hui shamsheer chali hai
lo zakhmi huwa sajdey mein damaad e nabi hai
duniya se chala dekhiye kaabe ka nigehbaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jibreel e amee'n khaak udaate huwe aaye
Adam bhi yehi nauha sunate huwe aaye
kis ko dam e mushkil mein pukarega musalmaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tu ne bine muljim(l.a.) ye sitam kaisa hai dhaya
sajde mein namazi ka lahu kyu hai bahaya
Abbas ko bachpan mein kiya chaak girebaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kaabe ki faseelo'n pe udaasi ki rida hai
aur qibla e awwal mein bhi kohraam bapa hai
sar khuld mein huraan e jinaa ne kiya uryaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hasnain ke sar par hai yateemi ka andhera
rukhsat huwa suraj ki nigaho'n se sawera
zam zam mein talatum hai to kausar mein hai tufaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Rehan hai rizwan e jinaa chaak girebaa'n
hai baagh e iram, baagh e fidak ki tarha giryaa
hasnain(a.s.) ka baba hai zara der ka mehmaa'n
